title: SidebarNav
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ModalNavigationDrawer, PermanentNavigationDrawer, ModalDrawerSheet, PermanentDrawerSheet and NavigationDrawerItem; androidx.compose.material3.NavigationRail with NavigationRailItem for the collapsed form
summary: Sections of destinations at the side of the app are the Material 3 navigation drawer: modal on a phone, permanent at expanded width, with NavigationDrawerItem rows, section headings and counts. Its collapsed, icon-only form is NavigationRail. Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: For an app with more destinations than fit a bottom bar, grouped in sections: a ModalNavigationDrawer opened from the top app bar on a phone, a PermanentNavigationDrawer on a tablet or desktop window.
whenNotToUse: For three to five top-level destinations use NavigationBar or NavigationSuiteScaffold (see top-nav). For actions use a menu. For a panel of content beside a list use a supporting pane (see peek-panel).
api: @Composable fun ModalNavigationDrawer(drawerContent: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, drawerState: DrawerState = rememberDrawerState(DrawerValue.Closed), gesturesEnabled: Boolean = true, scrimColor: Color = DrawerDefaults.scrimColor, content: @Composable () -> Unit)
@Composable fun PermanentNavigationDrawer(drawerContent: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, content: @Composable () -> Unit)

@Composable fun ModalDrawerSheet(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, drawerShape: Shape = DrawerDefaults.shape, drawerContainerColor: Color = DrawerDefaults.modalContainerColor, …, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun NavigationDrawerItem(label: @Composable () -> Unit, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, icon: @Composable (() -> Unit)? = null, badge: @Composable (() -> Unit)? = null, shape: Shape = NavigationDrawerTokens.ActiveIndicatorShape.value, colors: NavigationDrawerItemColors = NavigationDrawerItemDefaults.colors(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun NavigationRail(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, containerColor: Color = NavigationRailDefaults.ContainerColor, contentColor: Color = contentColorFor(containerColor), header: @Composable (ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null, windowInsets: WindowInsets = NavigationRailDefaults.windowInsets, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

states.name: current page
states.description: NavigationDrawerItem with selected = true has the subtle accent fill and the selected state.

states.name: with a count
states.description: A MonarchBadge in the badge slot follows the label.

states.name: nested group
states.description: A NavigationDrawerItem that toggles expanded, followed by its children indented with Modifier.padding(start = …).

states.name: collapsed
states.description: NavigationRail shows icons with short labels; the full drawer opens from a menu button.

appearance: The drawer sheet uses the raised background role (Material surfaceContainerLow), selected items the subtle accent role (secondaryContainer) with the strong accent role for text, and other items the muted text role. Section headings are MonarchText in the label style and the muted text role. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colors.
platformNotes: The web SidebarNav renders sections of links with nested groups, count badges with a tone, the current page from the path, an icon-only collapsed mode with tooltips, and a header and footer. On Android the rows are NavigationDrawerItem, which select a destination rather than follow a link; the current page is selected = true; badgeTone is a MonarchBadge in the badge slot; the collapsed mode is NavigationRail (with PlainTooltip on long press for the names); nested groups are rows the app expands; header and footer are ordinary content of the sheet. NavigationSuiteScaffold (see top-nav) chooses between bar, rail and drawer by window size. iOS uses a sidebar List in NavigationSplitView.
accessibility: System behavior: each NavigationDrawerItem is a 56dp-high selectable row with the tab role in a group, read with its label and selected state; the badge is read as part of it.
System behavior: a modal drawer is a pane announced when it opens; back and the scrim close it.
Mark section titles as headings so TalkBack users can jump between sections.
Give the collapsed rail labels, or a contentDescription on each icon; an icon alone is not a name.
The selected row has a fill and a state, not color on text alone.
edgeCases: A long label wraps in the drawer at large font sizes; the drawer is at most 360dp wide.
Drawer content taller than the screen must scroll: wrap it in Modifier.verticalScroll.
In right to left the drawer slides in from the right.

examples.title: Sections, nested groups and badges
examples.template:
PermanentNavigationDrawer(
    modifier = Modifier.height(640.dp),
    drawerContent = {
        PermanentDrawerSheet(modifier = Modifier.width(240.dp)) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
                NavigationDrawerItem(
                    shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                    label = { Text({{main.0.label}}) },
                    selected = current == "home",
                    onClick = { current = "home" },
                    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Home, contentDescription = null) },
                )
                NavigationDrawerItem(
                    shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                    label = { Text({{main.1.label}}) },
                    selected = current == "inbox",
                    onClick = { current = "inbox" },
                    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Inbox, contentDescription = null) },
                    badge = { MonarchBadge(text = {{main.1.badge}}.toString(), tone = MonarchTone.Accent, variant = MonarchBadgeVariant.Solid) },
                )
                NavigationDrawerItem(
                    shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                    label = { Text({{main.2.label}}) },
                    selected = current == "calendar",
                    onClick = { current = "calendar" },
                    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Calendar, contentDescription = null) },
                )
                MonarchText(text = {{teamsLabel}}.uppercase(), style = MonarchTextStyle.Label, color = MonarchTheme.colors.textMuted, heading = true)
                NavigationDrawerItem(
                    shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                    label = { Text({{teams.0.label}}) },
                    selected = false,
                    onClick = { designOpen = !designOpen },
                    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Users, contentDescription = null) },
                    badge = { MonarchIcon(if (designOpen) SampleIcons.ChevronDown else SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
                    modifier = Modifier.semantics { stateDescription = if (designOpen) "Expanded" else "Collapsed" },
                )
                if (designOpen) {
                    NavigationDrawerItem(
                        shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                        label = { Text({{teams.0.items.0.label}}) },
                        selected = current == "design-issues",
                        onClick = { current = "design-issues" },
                        badge = { MonarchBadge(text = {{teams.0.items.0.badge}}.toString(), tone = {{teams.0.items.0.badgeTone|tone}}) },
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(start = MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
                    )
                    NavigationDrawerItem(
                        shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                        label = { Text({{teams.0.items.1.label}}) },
                        selected = current == "design-backlog",
                        onClick = { current = "design-backlog" },
                        badge = { MonarchBadge(text = {{teams.0.items.1.badge}}.toString(), tone = {{teams.0.items.1.badgeTone|tone}}) },
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(start = MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
                    )
                }
                NavigationDrawerItem(
                    shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                    label = { Text({{teams.1.label}}) },
                    selected = false,
                    onClick = { researchOpen = !researchOpen },
                    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Users, contentDescription = null) },
                    badge = { MonarchIcon(if (researchOpen) SampleIcons.ChevronDown else SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
                    modifier = Modifier.semantics { stateDescription = if (researchOpen) "Expanded" else "Collapsed" },
                )
                if (researchOpen) {
                    NavigationDrawerItem(
                        shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                        label = { Text({{teams.1.items.0.label}}) },
                        selected = current == "research-issues",
                        onClick = { current = "research-issues" },
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(start = MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
                    )
                    NavigationDrawerItem(
                        shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                        label = { Text({{teams.1.items.1.label}}) },
                        selected = current == "research-notes",
                        onClick = { current = "research-notes" },
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(start = MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
                    )
                }
                MonarchText(text = {{workspaceLabel}}.uppercase(), style = MonarchTextStyle.Label, color = MonarchTheme.colors.textMuted, heading = true)
                NavigationDrawerItem(
                    shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                    label = { Text({{settings.label}}) },
                    selected = current == "settings",
                    onClick = { current = "settings" },
                    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Settings, contentDescription = null) },
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(MonarchTheme.spacing.space12))
                MonarchDivider()
                NavigationDrawerItem(
                    shape = MonarchTheme.shapes.md,
                    label = { Text("Collapse sidebar") },
                    selected = false,
                    onClick = {},
                    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.PanelLeft, contentDescription = null) },
                )
            }
        }
    },
) {}
